findings.source_passage: I gave him the Evil Eye. "What do you think?"
findings.source_locator: paragraph 4, narrator's first line of dialogue
findings.why_it_matters: The capitalized 'Evil Eye' is a small but characteristically comic, narrator-voiced gesture; the draft drops the action beat entirely and keeps only the dialogue, erasing the narrator's sardonic physical register.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'gave him the Evil Eye' action tag before the dialogue line.

findings.source_passage: He was about seventy with more wrinkles than an unsettled pond.
findings.source_locator: paragraph describing Jethro, midway through the Portal scene
findings.why_it_matters: This simile ('more wrinkles than an unsettled pond') is one of the chapter's few distinctively comic/literary lines; the draft keeps it but embeds it in a clipped clause that strips its stand-alone comic timing.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the simile its own sentence as in the source: 'He was about seventy with more wrinkles than an unsettled pond.'

findings.source_passage: Something on the ground caught my attention. I stooped and picked it up to turn it in my fingers. It was a bit of compressed clay dropped from the tire of the pig-men's truck.
findings.source_locator: after the explanation of why dragons made the Portal, before the clay-clod question
findings.why_it_matters: The source makes the narrator's discovery a deliberate three-beat observation (noticing, examining, identifying); the draft collapses it to a single clause, losing the investigative rhythm that frames her deductive question.
findings.suggested_fix: Expand to at least two beats: the narrator spots something, picks it up, recognizes it as clay from the pig-men's tire, then displays it to Xander.

findings.source_passage: Our shadows ghosted over the needled tops as the sun set to our right. A cool wind whipped my hair over my face and over my bare arms.
findings.source_locator: second paragraph of the flight scene
findings.why_it_matters: The shadow-ghosting image and the detail of bare arms are small atmospheric/sensory anchors that establish the protagonist's physical vulnerability in flight; both are omitted in the draft's compressed opening.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the shadow-on-treetops image and the bare-arms shiver detail to the flight paragraph.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; two medium findings (loss of 'Evil Eye' action beat and flattening of the wrinkles simile's comic timing) and two low findings, falling below the regeneration threshold.
